build.detail:
curl 8.22.0 (x86_64-pc-linux-gnu) libcurl/8.22.0 OpenSSL/3.6.4 zlib/1.2.13
Release-Date: 2026-09-02
Protocols: file ftp ftps http https ipfs ipns ws wss
Features: alt-svc HSTS HTTPS-proxy IPv6 Largefile libz SSL threadsafe UnixSockets

functional.detail: TLS 1.3 verified fetch of the authority s_server (HTTP 200) with an unrelated CA rejected

historical_failures.summary: the candidate's SSL_CTX_set_min_proto_version/SSL_CTX_set_max_proto_version returned 0, so curl's TLS setup failed before a request was sent

historical_failures.fixed_by: e7b50d10 (ssl: expose the peer certificate/chain and fix the post-handshake read path)
historical_failures.summary: curl fetched HTTPS without verifying the chain: the peer certificate/chain was not exposed and the post-handshake read path stalled

start.detail: the candidate-linked curl runs and reports -V

build.detail: Git 2.56.0, SHA-1/SHA-256 via the candidate libcrypto

functional.detail: SHA-1/SHA-256 object hashing agrees with GNU coreutils; HTTPS push/clone/pull with both TLS endpoints on the candidate, unrelated CA rejected; bounded t/ subset green

historical_failures.summary: Git's HTTPS transport could not complete end to end because candidate-linked nginx (the test server) carried the five TLS defects above

historical_failures.fixed_by: bb5958a9 (p17: the Git downstream passes its own tests and pushes/clones/pulls over HTTPS via the candidate)
historical_failures.summary: the Git downstream had no reproducing harness: its own t/ subset and an HTTPS push/clone/pull were not yet exercised against the candidate

known_residuals: t5540-http-push-webdav is skipped: Git is built without expat (the court image ships no libexpat headers); it is a plain-HTTP path with no OpenSSL use

start.detail: the candidate-linked git runs and hashes objects

build.detail: HAProxy 3.0.29, built with the candidate OpenSSL 3.6.4

functional.detail: TLS 1.3 termination in front of a plain-HTTP backend for the authority s_client and the candidate curl; backend UP/L7OK; broken config rejected

historical_failures.fixed_by: a742f27d (ssl: fix the HAProxy crash and handshake: SNI arg ctrl, client_hello_cb, ERR constant)
historical_failures.summary: candidate-linked HAProxy 3.0.29 SIGSEGV'd on the first TLS handshake: SSL_CTX_set_tlsext_servername_arg (SSL_CTRL_SET_TLSEXT_SERVERNAME_ARG=54) had no SSL_CTX_ctrl arm, so the servername callback's priv argument stayed NULL and ssl_sock_switchctx_err_cbk dereferenced it

start.detail: the frontend binds and reaches readiness

functional.detail: TLS 1.3 termination for the authority s_client and the candidate curl, 16/16 concurrent verified fetches, reload 2->3 workers, post-handshake NewSessionTicket + TLS 1.3 resumption

historical_failures.fixed_by: 3e1c5313 (ssl: fix the nginx-exposed defects: SNI, ticket cb, close_notify, EOF option, record resync)
historical_failures.summary: nginx 1.26.3 exposed five candidate defects: SNI disabled (tlsext servername callback returned 0), TLS session tickets disabled, no close_notify teardown after Connection: close, SSL_OP_IGNORE_UNEXPECTED_EOF not honoured, and an intermittent server-side handshake stall under concurrency

start.detail: the TLS listener starts and answers an authority s_client

functional.detail: live sshd+ssh login, the forced kex/cipher/MAC/host-key matrix including RSA/ECDSA, ssh-keygen RSA/ECDSA/Ed25519 sign+verify, and the regress unit suite

historical_failures.fixed_by: 52b61567 (evp: legacy-origin EVP_PKEY signs/verifies -- OpenSSH RSA/ECDSA fixed)
historical_failures.summary: OpenSSH's RSA and ECDSA signing/verification and the parsing of native openssh-key-v1 RSA/ECDSA private keys failed with `error in libcrypto: initialization error`, so RSA/ECDSA host keys and user keys were rejected and the handshake fell back to Ed25519

known_residuals: `regress/unittests/utf8` aborts on both the candidate and the authority: the court image ships only C/C.utf8/POSIX locales and the test setlocale()s en_US.UTF-8

start.detail: the candidate-linked sshd starts on a high port

functional.detail: live TLS 1.3 with an unrelated CA rejected, plus CPython's own bounded test_ssl: 172 passed, 0 failed, 0 errors

historical_failures.fixed_by: e7b50d10 (ssl: expose the peer certificate/chain and fix the post-handshake read path)
historical_failures.summary: CPython's _ssl accepted a server certificate signed by an unrelated CA: the candidate had no certificate-verification path, and the post-handshake read stalled when the caller's buffer was smaller than the record

historical_failures.fixed_by: 27b3e300 (ssl: TLS1.2 session creation, tickets and resumption -- CPython test_ssl all-green)
historical_failures.summary: CPython's own test_ssl stood at 153 passing methods while TLS 1.2 session creation/ALPN/SNI/alerts and the server-side gaps remained

start.detail: the interpreter starts and its ssl/hashlib surface answers
